uxrocket.Summary: Product analytics with a data-grounded AI assistant, configurable funnels, and session replay for investigating conversion drop-offs.
Challenge: Product teams needed to connect changes in metrics and funnel conversion to actual user behavior. They also needed an assistant that could answer questions using customer data and product documentation.
Session replay had to remain useful for high-traffic customers with different storage budgets.
Solution: Built a conversational assistant that queries metrics, segments and funnels through backend APIs. Added a RAG pipeline for documentation with chunking, embeddings, semantic search and source links. Used calculated A/B test results to ground experiment summaries.
Reworked Sankey journey calculations, built configurable funnel components and APIs, and linked Rocket Play sessions to cohorts and reports.
Added fixed and dynamic sampling, prioritized problematic sessions, and implemented quotas, usage tracking and paid MP4 exports.
Outcome: Teams can move from a conversion drop-off in a report to the relevant session and inspect the user interaction behind it.
The assistant can answer product and analytics questions with relevant data or documentation. Quotas and MP4 export support paid Rocket Play plans.

bats-crm.Summary: I worked on BATS CRM, integrating secure payments and supporting the existing .NET application during modernization.
Challenge: BATS CRM had to keep serving dealerships while fragmented installations were consolidated. My work focused on adding secure payments and keeping the existing MVC application available during infrastructure changes.
Solution: I integrated Mastercard payment forms, 3D Secure and PCI-compliant processing into the MVC application.
I migrated and renewed SSL certificates in Azure App Service without downtime. I used Application Insights to identify and fix more than 50 critical production errors.
Outcome: The integration supported monthly payment processing without integration-related failures. Fixing the errors reduced production incidents by 80%.
The CRM rollout unified 12 dealership groups on one platform. Support tickets fell by 60%, and daily reporting went from four hours to 15 minutes.
RelatedWork: Built a Microsoft Teams bot that records and transcribes meetings. Added an agent workflow and RAG to summarize transcripts, extract decisions and action items, and answer questions from the recordings.
Built a content platform with Telegram OAuth and user-generated content. It reached 2,000+ active users in three months.
Automated leave approvals with Timetastic webhooks and Teams and Slack notifications. Processing went from 48 hours to under two.

acuitive-solutions.Summary: Logistics audit portal with live shipment tracking, invoice workflows, and secure reporting for multiple clients.
Challenge: Logistics auditors had to reconcile invoices and waybills manually while tracking shipments and preparing reports. The portal needed to handle clients processing more than 10 million waybills per month and keep each client’s audit data separate.
Solution: Built an audit portal with real-time invoice and shipment statuses, interactive tables and dashboards. Added a standalone Google Maps application for tracking delivery events.
Implemented granular role-based access and multi-tenant support. Added secure report links, email delivery, and import and export in Excel, CSV and PDF.
Outcome: Manual invoice processing time dropped by 80%. Report preparation and distribution time dropped by 75%.

medeanalytics.Summary: Incremental migration of a healthcare analytics monolith to .NET Core microservices with automated tests and production monitoring.
Challenge: A legacy .NET Framework monolith was difficult to scale and change. Limited automated coverage and scattered logs made regressions and production incidents harder to diagnose.
Solution: Helped split the monolith into .NET Core services and introduced asynchronous messaging through RabbitMQ and NServiceBus.
Expanded the test suite from 200 to 500 tests, updated the MongoDB driver and automated quality checks with SonarQube. Set up centralized logging with ELK and metrics dashboards in Grafana.
Outcome: Customer-reported errors fell by 60%. Centralized logs and metrics shortened incident diagnosis and recovery.

real-estate.Summary: Property search and interactive maps with a backend API for analytics dashboards.
Challenge: Users needed faster listing search and a way to inspect rental properties on a map. The team also needed an API that could handle dashboard traffic.
Solution: Implemented and tuned Elasticsearch for property listings. Built the dashboard API and integrated Mapbox to show rental details on the map.
Added reusable Mustache.js templates for listing emails.
Outcome: Average search response time fell by 20%. Users could explore rental details on the map, and the marketing team could reuse email templates for listings.
